To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the New York Freedom of Information Law, I hereby request the following records:

All Weekly Hunger Strike Reports, (WKLYHNGRRPT) SYSM E-Form, filed during calendar year 2026.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Chris Gelardi

To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Nevada Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

1) The agreement between Will Witt, Riley Gaines, Nala Ray, Jeff Dye, and/or Turning Point USA that permitted the event to be held at the University of Nevada, Reno on October 5th, 2026.
2) Any financial agreements pertaining to this on-campus event, including but not limited to guest speaker costs, security costs, and event space costs. 
3) Security requirements for this event, and who was financially responsible for those security requirements. 
4) The name of any on-campus organization/club responsible for organizing the event, and the amount they paid for the speaker, if warranted. 
5) If not an on-campus or campus-affiliated organization, the name of the group responsible for organizing the event.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Judah Trease
